name: manual_8f0100
claim: Use temporary reversible redirects only after qualifying the HTML route matrix on both hosts; keep API and WebSocket contracts outside page consolidation.

decisions.notes: Orama #534 did not qualify or activate the route changes. Mac and Windows have distinct legacy entry points and consumers. Verify status, auth, deep links and rollback before retiring either view.
